name: Reduce Background Input Hooks
description: Disables Game DVR background recording to reduce input latency in games and applications. This stops Windows from capturing your gameplay for the Xbox app, which can improve responsiveness.

description_i18n.en: Disables Game DVR background recording to reduce input latency in games and applications. This stops Windows from capturing your gameplay for the Xbox app, which can improve responsiveness.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die Hintergrundaufnahme von Game DVR, um Eingabeverzögerungen in Spielen und Anwendungen zu reduzieren. Dies verhindert, dass Windows Ihre Gameplay-Aufnahmen für das Xbox-App erfasst, was die Reaktionsfähigkeit verbessern kann.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive l'enregistrement en arrière-plan de Game DVR pour réduire la latence d'entrée dans les jeux et applications. Cela empêche Windows d'enregistrer votre gameplay pour l'app Xbox, ce qui peut améliorer la réactivité.

warnings.title: Xbox app recording disabled
warnings.message: Disabling this feature prevents the Xbox Game Bar from capturing gameplay for clips or screenshots. You will need to use other methods if you want to record your screen

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies two registry values: AppCaptureEnabled and GameDVR_Enabled under HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\GameDVR and HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore
